process: the monarchy is hereditary; following legislative elections, the monarch usually proposes as president the leader of the majority party or coalition, who is then indirectly elected by the Congress of Deputies; vice president and Council of Ministers appointed by the president
results: Congress of Deputies vote - 179 to 171 (16 November 2023)
cabinet: Council of Ministers designated by the president
